records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like naproxen, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. Most studies on NSAIDs, including naproxen, have not shown an increased chance of birth defects.
records.source_section: Does taking naproxen increase the chance of birth defects?
